newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pulp mulls global shr or rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp mulls global shr or rights offer.

text.p: Asia Pulp & Paper Co Ltd said Monday it is contemplating a global share or rights offering to raise capital.
The pulp and paper company said it is mulling the offering in connection with its consideration of possible secondary listings in Asian markets for its common stock.

A company spokeswoman declined to elaborate on the offering's size and timing, other than saying it will depend on capital requirements and market conditions. She added Asia Pulp had not yet determined on which Asian exchanges it wants to list its stock.
The spokeswoman said two of the company's subsidiaries, Pabrik Kertas Tjiwi Kimia PT and Indah Kiat Pulp & Paper Corp PT, are already listed on the Jakarta exchange.
Asia Pulp added its controlling shareholder APP Global Ltd indicated it intends to subscribe for a significant portion of the offering.
The company's stock traded unchanged at 15-1/8 Monday morning, close to its 52-week high of 15-3/8.
